content.title: 4-8-2-3. Single-family detached, duplex, and multiplex lighting standards.
content.summary:
A.	Generally. Exterior lighting on single-family detached, duplex, and multiplex uses shall conform to the requirements of this section.
B.	Exterior Fixture Type and Configuration. Fixtures shall emit no more than 850 lumens.
